6.55 rsInvalidBooleanConstant
rsInvalidBooleanConstant is a critical error that will occur when an element that requires a Boolean
value or the value of a Boolean expression is not set to one of the constant values "1", "0", "True"
(with uppercase T), or "False" (with uppercase F).
